result.document_summary: A portion of a San Diego Municipal Code web page (Chapter 2, Council Rules 2.9-7.8) covering City Council procedure, with no rental housing content.
result.notes: Although the page URL points to San Diego's prohibition on algorithmic rent-setting (Division 11, section 98.1103), this part of the document contains only City Council rules of procedure (debate, conduct, voting, selection of the Council President, committees, agenda posting). No rule in any of the six rental housing categories appears in this part, so no records are extracted.
